output.headline: Adds $664,527 and extends to 2026 the state refugee school grant for newcomer students
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The text gives the original term as starting October 01, 2021 and also as July 1st, 2021, and the extension wording ('from October 01, 2021 to September 30, 2024 to June 30, 2026') is garbled.
output.summary: The district is amending its California Department of Social Services Refugee School Impact Program grant, adding $664,527.03 and raising the total from $110,000.00 to $774,527.03. The amendment also extends the grant period to June 30, 2026. The text lists conflicting start dates for the original term.

output.headline: Adds $726,766 to Arntz Builders' contract for the Cole Campus Central Administration Center
output.summary: This change order pays Arntz Builders for additional construction work covered by several preliminary change orders (PCOs) on the Cole Campus Central Administration Center Project. It raises the contract price from $38,572,174.81 to $39,298,940.56. All other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Awards Overaa Construction up to $49M to modernize Roosevelt Middle School

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $49,000,000.00

output.summary: Overaa Construction will provide preconstruction and construction services for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project under a lease-leaseback agreement, a contracting method in which the builder is paid through lease payments. Work is scheduled to start August 24, 2023 and end when the final payment is due, estimated for December 31, 2027. The Facilities Committee recommended the award.

output.headline: Hires Jensen Hughes for up to $26,565 to design fire and intrusion alarm changes at Community Day School
output.summary: Jensen Hughes, Inc. will design changes to the existing fire and intrusion alarms in portable 100 for the Community Day School Fire & Intrusion Alarm Design Services Project. The amount includes up to $2,415.00 for additional services. Work is scheduled from August 24, 2023 to October 31, 2023.

output.headline: Adds $205,750 and time for Shah Kawasaki Architects on the Cole Administration Center
output.summary: This amendment adds construction administration support and commissioning and close-out services to Shah Kawasaki Architects' work on the Cole Administration Center Project. It raises the not-to-exceed amount from $3,890,875.00 to $4,096,625.00 and extends the term from December 31, 2023 to August 30, 2024. All other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $37,950 for Sandis surveying and utility locating at East Oakland Pride Elementary
output.summary: Sandis Civil Engineers Surveyors Planners will provide surveying, utility locating and additional services if needed for the paving and site improvements at East Oakland Pride Elementary. The amount includes a $3,450.00 contingency. Work runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024, and the Board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Pays Better Together Audiology up to $109,300 for hearing services for Deaf and hard-of-hearing students

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $109,300.00

output.summary: Better Together Audiology will assess how hearing loss affects students' access to school, fit and monitor hearing assistive technology, and train staff on using and troubleshooting hearing devices. It will also advise staff and families and recommend changes to the learning environment. The agreement runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024 through the Special Education Department.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $49,900 for EDU Healthcare to provide a school-based physical therapist

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $49,900.00

output.summary: EDU Healthcare will provide physical therapy to students with Individualized Education Programs (IEPs), including assessments, meetings, progress reports, Medi-Cal billing and consultation with staff and families. The agreement covers July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024 through the Special Education Department. The Board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Partners with Cal Poly Humboldt on teacher and counselor intern and fieldwork programs at no cost
output.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Cal Poly Humboldt sets up intern and fieldwork placements in Oakland schools for people earning teaching credentials and pupil personnel services credentials, such as counseling, mental health and special education. It runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026 and costs the General Fund nothing.

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $46,526.00

output.summary: The district is paying Gartner, Inc. for information technology research and advisory services (a Gartner for IT Leaders Individual Access Advisor subscription) for the Technology Services Department. The agreement covers July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024. The Board is approving it after the fact.

output.headline: Hires LCA Architects for up to $545,159 on East Oakland Pride Elementary site improvements
output.summary: LCA Architects will do site investigation, design reports, as-built drawings and schematic design for the East Oakland Pride Elementary School Site Improvements Project. The amount includes $477,417.00 for basic services, $47,742.00 for additional services and $20,000.00 for reimbursable expenses. Work is scheduled from August 24, 2023 to December 30, 2024.

output.headline: Accepts $318,420 WorkAbility I grant for job and college prep for special education students
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The text calls this the 2022-2023 Grant Funding Application but says it covers Fiscal Year 2023-24.
output.summary: The district is accepting a $318,420.00 WorkAbility I grant from the California Department of Education. It pays for instruction and support toward employment and post-secondary education for students in the district's special education local plan area (SELPA) for fiscal year 2023-24.

output.headline: Ratifies no-cost partnership with Asian Health Services for health centers at three schools through 2027
output.summary: Under this no-cost memorandum of understanding, Asian Health Services will run school-based health centers at Oakland High, Lincoln Elementary and Franklin Elementary. The centers cover medical, dental and mental health, health education and youth development, and work with other providers on campus. It runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2027.

output.headline: Ratifies no-cost partnership with Native American Health Center for school health centers through 2027
output.summary: Under this no-cost memorandum of understanding, the Native American Health Centers will partner with Madison Park Academy, Skyline High, Life Academy, Frick and Bret Harte schools. The services cover medical, dental and mental health, health education and youth development, along with other wrap-around support. It runs July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2027.

output.headline: Buys $76,042 of playground matting tiles from Sof Surfaces for Esperanza at Stonehurst Elementary School without bidding
output.summary: The district is buying rubber playmatting tiles and related products from Sof Surfaces, Inc. to cover asphalt and support the new play structure at Esperanza at Stonehurst Elementary School. The Board is declaring that public bidding would be futile, so the purchase skips the district's own competitive bid. Delivery is due by August 25, 2023.

output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that states the district's support for net energy metering for school solar projects. The text states no cost.

output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that follows the Measure G1 oversight commission's recommendation to approve 2023-2024 Measure G1 grant proposals for named schools.
